faqs.q: What signs indicate I need a professional termite inspection in Cantonment, FL?
faqs.a: Mud tubes, discarded wings, damaged or hollow-sounding wood, and termite-like insects can be reasons to arrange an inspection. Some evidence may be less obvious, making professional evaluation useful. Breeze Pest Control examines accessible areas for observable signs and relevant conditions before discussing the findings with the property owner.

faqs.q: Should older homes in Cantonment, FL receive termite inspections?
faqs.a: Older homes can benefit from termite inspections because construction features, previous repairs, moisture exposure, and aging materials may create areas worth evaluating. An inspection does not assume termites are present. Breeze Pest Control assesses accessible portions of the property for observable activity and conditions that may require further attention.

faqs.q: When should I schedule a termite inspection before buying a home in Cantonment, FL?
